about.description: Cruisin' Tikis appears to be a floating tiki bar boat tour company, offering guests a unique on-the-water experience with a tropical tiki theme. Guests cruise aboard decorated tiki boats while enjoying drinks and scenic waterway views.
about.elevator_pitch: Set sail on a one-of-a-kind floating tiki bar experience where tropical vibes, refreshing drinks, and stunning waterway views combine for an unforgettable adventure.
about.vibe: Tropical, festive, relaxed floating tiki party
about.insider_tip: Book in advance as tiki boat tours tend to fill up quickly, especially on weekends.
